WITH driver_drives AS (
    SELECT year, driver_id, constructor_id, first_round, last_round,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year, driver_id ORDER BY first_round) as rn
    FROM drives 
    WHERE constructor_id != -1
),
gaps AS (
    SELECT 
        a.year,
        a.driver_id,
        a.constructor_id as prev_constructor,
        a.last_round as prev_last_round,
        b.constructor_id as next_constructor,
        b.first_round as next_first_round,
        b.first_round - a.last_round - 1 as gap_size,
        a.last_round + 1 as first_missed_round,
        b.first_round - 1 as last_missed_round
    FROM driver_drives a
    JOIN driver_drives b ON a.year = b.year AND a.driver_id = b.driver_id AND a.rn = b.rn - 1
),
qualified_gaps AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM gaps
    WHERE gap_size > 0 AND gap_size < 3 AND prev_constructor != next_constructor
),
year_totals AS (
    SELECT year, driver_id, SUM(gap_size) as total_races_missed
    FROM qualified_gaps
    GROUP BY year, driver_id
),
final_gaps AS (
    SELECT qg.*
    FROM qualified_gaps qg
    JOIN year_totals yt ON qg.year = yt.year AND qg.driver_id = yt.driver_id
    WHERE yt.total_races_missed < 3
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(AVG(first_missed_round), 4) as avg_first_round,
    ROUND(AVG(last_missed_round), 4) as avg_last_round,
    COUNT(*) as num_instances
FROM final_gaps
